# motionwind-vanilla

Write Motion animations as Tailwind-like `animate-*` classes in plain HTML/JS — no framework. It
scans the DOM and wires animations with the [Motion](https://motion.dev) vanilla API. Same class
syntax as the rest of motionwind.

## Install (npm)

```bash
npm install motionwind-vanilla motion
```

```js
import { motionwind } from "motionwind-vanilla";
const stop = motionwind();          // scans document, returns a cleanup fn
```

### Options

```ts
motionwind({
  root,                  // ParentNode to scan (default: document)
  selector,              // default: '[class*="animate-"]'
  respectReducedMotion,  // default: true — honor prefers-reduced-motion
  observe,               // default: false — MutationObserver wires elements added later (SPA/HTMX)
});
```

## Install (CDN, zero build)

Self-contained bundle (Motion included), auto-initializes on load:

```html
<script src="https://unpkg.com/motionwind-vanilla"></script>
<button class="animate-hover:scale-110 animate-tap:scale-90 animate-spring">Click me</button>
<!-- window.motionwind.motionwind(opts) to re-scan with options -->
```

## Behavior

- **Supported:** initial/enter, hover, tap, focus, in-view, and scroll-linked (`animate-scroll:*`).
- **Idempotent:** wiring strips the `animate-*` classes, so re-running never double-wires.
- **Reduced motion:** with `prefers-reduced-motion`, elements jump to their final/visible state
  with no animation and gestures/scroll are skipped.
- **Dynamic DOM:** pass `{ observe: true }` to animate elements added after init.
- **Not supported (need a component runtime):** drag, layout, exit, and variant *propagation* —
  use `motionwind-react` or `motionwind-vue` for those.

## Class syntax (summary)

`animate-{hover|tap|focus|inview|initial|enter}:{prop}-{value}`, transitions like
`animate-duration-300 animate-spring animate-ease-in-out`, viewport `animate-once animate-amount-50`,
scroll `animate-scroll:y-[0,-200] animate-scroll-container`. See motionwind-core for the full grammar.
